event: An empirical study of GPT-4.1, Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite, Llama 3.3 70B, and Mistral Medium 3.5 reported that open-ended responses to welfare-relevant questions grew longer after criticism and shifted toward words such as “frustrating” and “challenging.” (OpenAI, Google, Meta, and Mistral AI, 2026-11-15.)
